payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results comparing XLNet with BERT and RoBERTa on negation detection and scope resolution tasks, indicating XLNet's superior performance.

claims.text: XLNet outperforms BERT and RoBERTa on negation detection and scope resolution tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the BioScope Corpus and SFU Review Corpus.
XLNet shows a consistent trend of outperforming RoBERTa in negation detection and scope resolution tasks, contrary to results on benchmark GLUE tasks.
